slides.title: Dental office manager in the 7:45 AM huddle:

slides.label: Today's schedule
slides.title: Zoned out.
slides.body: Two crowns, one new patient, a 3:00 that always runs late.

slides.label: "Is my X-ray certificate still good?"
slides.title: LISTENING EAR ACTIVATED.
slides.body: Which assistant. When did it get renewed. Where is the card.

slides.label: "When does malpractice renew?"
slides.title: Fully awake now.
slides.body: Year-end renewals are coming whether we talk about them or not.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Some words just hit different.
slides.body: Staff licenses, CPR cards, X-ray certificates, business license, liability and malpractice. Know every date before the huddle does.
